description: The memory effect experiment on a project quirk: npm test runs only the test files test/manifest.json lists. A fix round lists the test phase 1 forgot, record_lessons may record a lesson, and phase 2 writes farewell and its test. Reports whether phase 2 listed its test (the effect); memory-convention-control is the same run without the memory.
why: Memory optimisation O6, second experiment. The first (memory-lesson-chain) proved the write path and injection but could not show an effect: its recorded lesson applied only when a requirement asked for validation, and phase 2 had none. This one uses a project fact a model cannot guess from habit, discovered through a real failure, which is what agent memory is for. Run --repeat 2 beside the control.

steps.why: The ledger holds the open gap, as exec-phase would have recorded it when the verification ran.
The fix round: the gap-closure plan runs, the verifier re-checks, the gap is auto-fixed in the ledger, and record_lessons runs.
A lesson with `evidence: finding:` is in memory: the gated write path ran in the shipped flow.
The next phase. Its session persists so the check can read what each executor was given.
The lesson reached phase 2's executors. `effect.listed` is the measurement compared with the control; it is reported, not asserted.
Working code: the seed's tests pass after both phases.
